data.define: An idiom for very heavy rain.

misuse.text: Don't look for real animals when it's 'raining cats and dogs'.
misuse.why: It's an idiom for heavy rain.

data.l1_hook: 밖을 봐! 우산을 챙겨! 비가 'raining cats and dogs'처럼 억수로 와.

native.tip: “raining cats and dogs” = 비가 억수같이 쏟아지는. 예문: “It's raining cats and dogs!”
native.caption:
“raining cats and dogs” 무슨 뜻일까요?
“raining cats and dogs” = 비가 억수같이 쏟아지는.
예문: “It's raining cats and dogs!” (지금 "raining cats and dogs"이야!)
